SEARCH
Package chess.service

Class Game

java.lang.Object
chess.service.Game
public class Game extends Object
Runs a game of chess: holds the board and both players, tracks whose turn it is, and checks every move against the rules before carrying it out.

Game never reads input or prints output. It returns a MoveResult that the user interface displays, so the same class works for the console now and a GUI later.

This is a simplified prototype. Pawns promote to a queen automatically, and the game announces when a king is in check. Checkmate, stalemate, castling and en passant are not implemented, and a player may make a move that leaves their own king in check. The game ends when a king is captured.

  • Method Details

    • start

      public final void start()
      Sets up the starting position, gives White the first move, and clears any winner and the move history. Also used to restart a game. It is final because the constructor calls it, so subclasses can't change it.

    • tryMove

      public MoveResult tryMove(Position from, Position to)
      Tries to move the current player's piece from one square to another.

      The move is checked in this order: game not over, the piece moves, there is a piece to move, it belongs to the current player, the destination isn't a friendly piece, the path is clear, and the piece's movement rules allow it. If any check fails, nothing changes and the result explains why.

      After a legal move, a pawn on the far rank is promoted to a queen, the move is added to the history, and the turn passes to the other player, who is warned if their king is in check.

      Parameters:
      from - the square of the piece to move
      to - the destination square
      Returns:
      a successful result with a description of the move, or a failed result explaining why the move was rejected

    • applyMove

      private MoveResult applyMove(Piece piece, Position from, Position to)
      Carries out a move that has already passed every check: moves the piece, handles capture and promotion, records the move, and switches turns.
      Parameters:

      from - its starting square
      to - its destination
      Returns:
      a successful result describing everything that happened

    • recordMove

      private void recordMove(Piece piece, Position from, Position to, Piece captured, boolean promoted)
      Adds a move to the history in a short readable form, such as "3. White knight F3 x E5" for a capture or "5. White pawn A7 - A8 =Q" for a promotion.
      Parameters:
      piece - the piece that moved
      from - its starting square
      to - its destination
      captured - the piece it took, or null
      promoted - whether it was promoted to a queen

    • isInCheck

      public boolean isInCheck(PieceColor color)
      Checks whether a side's king could be captured by an enemy piece on the next move. Each enemy piece is asked for its possible moves, so this reuses every piece's own movement rules.
      Parameters:
      color - the side whose king to check
      Returns:
      true if any enemy piece can reach that king
